from manim import *
import numpy as np

class TeachingScene(Scene):
    def setup_layout(self, title_text, lecture_lines):
        # BASE
        self.camera.background_color = "#000000"
        self.title = Text(title_text, font_size=28, color=WHITE).to_edge(UP)
        self.add(self.title)

        # Left-side lecture content (bullets with "-")
        lecture_texts = [Text(line, font_size=22, color=WHITE) for line in lecture_lines]
        self.lecture = VGroup(*lecture_texts).arrange(DOWN, aligned_edge=LEFT).scale(0.8)
        self.lecture.to_edge(LEFT, buff=0.2)
        self.add(self.lecture)

        # Define fine-grained animation grid (4x4 grid on right side)
        self.grid = {}
        rows = ["A", "B", "C", "D", "E", "F"]  # Top to bottom
        cols = ["1", "2", "3", "4", "5", "6"]  # Left to right

        for i, row in enumerate(rows):
            for j, col in enumerate(cols):
                x = 0.5 + j * 1
                y = 2.2 - i * 1
                self.grid[f"{row}{col}"] = np.array([x, y, 0])

    def place_at_grid(self, mobject, grid_pos, scale_factor=1.0):
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(self.grid[grid_pos])
        return mobject

    def place_in_area(self, mobject, top_left, bottom_right, scale_factor=1.0):
        tl_pos = self.grid[top_left]
        br_pos = self.grid[bottom_right]
        
        # Calculate center of the area
        center_x = (tl_pos[0] + br_pos[0]) / 2
        center_y = (tl_pos[1] + br_pos[1]) / 2
        center = np.array([center_x, center_y, 0])
        
        mobject.scale(scale_factor)
        mobject.move_to(center)
        return mobject

class Section3Scene(TeachingScene):
    def construct(self):
        lecture_lines = [
            "Two narrow distributions represent specific uncertainties.",
            "Adding them shifts the mean to the right.",
            "The final curve is wider due to added variance.",
            "This visual superposition confirms the rule of summation.",
            "Uncertainty grows as we combine independent processes."
        ]
        self.setup_layout("Visualizing Uncertainty Accumulation", lecture_lines)
        
        # Grid setup
        grid = VGroup()
        for i in range(2):
            for j in range(3):
                dot = Dot(color=WHITE)
                grid.add(dot)
        grid.arrange_grid(rows=2, cols=3, buff=0.5)
        self.place_in_area(grid, 'B2', 'E5', scale_factor=1.5)

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 1 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[0].animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        
        # Color rows in #FF5733 and columns in #33FF57
        row1 = VGroup(grid[0], grid[1], grid[2])
        row2 = VGroup(grid[3], grid[4], grid[5])
        self.play(row1.animate.set_color("#FF5733"), row2.animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        
        col1 = VGroup(grid[0], grid[3])
        col2 = VGroup(grid[1], grid[4])
        col3 = VGroup(grid[2], grid[5])
        self.play(col1.animate.set_color("#33FF57"), col2.animate.set_color("#33FF57"), col3.animate.set_color("#33FF57"))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 2 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[1].animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        # Animate moving a single row to reveal the structure
        self.play(row2.animate.shift(RIGHT * 1.5))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 3 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[2].animate.set_color("#33FFBD"))
        # Change color of the grid border to #33FFBD
        border = SurroundingRectangle(grid, color="#33FFBD", buff=0.2)
        self.play(Create(border))

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 4 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[3].animate.set_color("#33FFBD"))
        # Just emphasis, no complex movement per instructions

        # === Animation for Lecture Line 5 ===
        self.play(self.lecture[4].animate.set_color("#FF5733"))
        # Fade out grid and show the multiplication result '6'
        result = Text("6", font_size=48, color=WHITE)
        self.place_at_grid(result, 'D4')
        self.play(FadeOut(grid), FadeOut(border), FadeIn(result))
        self.wait(1)
